summary: SDKs should automatically label worker-emitted metrics with `temporal_worker_deployment_name` and `temporal_worker_build_id` (similar to existing `temporal_namespace` labeling) to eliminate manual setup and reduce errors.
userImpact: Users currently must manually add deployment and build ID labels to worker metrics, leading to inconsistent labeling and difficulty managing per-version metrics.
proposedFix: Automatically label worker metrics with `temporal_worker_deployment_name` and `temporal_worker_build_id` (use `__unversioned__` for unversioned workers)
keyQuote: SDK should label worker metrics with standardized `temporal_worker_deployment_name` and `temporal_worker_build_id` labels, similar to how it automatically labels with `temporal_namespace`.
